review_candidates.title: Workforce Management Lead (Starmatic Exp Required)
review_candidates.description: Why Join enablesGROUP? Since 2016, enablesGROUP has been on a mission: to deliver high-quality operations and outsourcing services to every client, big or small. Fast forward to 2026, we’ve grown our global footprint to serve 100+ clients and expanded into 4 key industries. At enablesGROUP, you’re not just joining a company – you’re joining a community that values growth, learning, and success. Check us out at www.enablesgroup.com. At enablesGROUP, you’re not just joining a company – you’re joining a community that values growth, learning, and success. We have market leading engagement scores and invest heavily in your Learning and Development, with a specific focus on enhancing your ability to leverage AI in your daily tasks. Our Perks & Benefits include: Comprehensive health and life insurance starting Day 1, covering 2 eligible dependents. 20 leave credits for vacation and emergency. Endless opportunities for career advancement with annual performance reviews and salary increases. Company-provided laptop to set you up for success. Convenient office location in Pasig , at the heart of Manila, accessible to all. Loyalty rewards: Employees celebrating 5 years could receive a profit-sharing scheme. In-house learning & development programs with access to the latest in AI and technology. Job Title: Workforce Management Lead Location: Ortigas, Pasig, PH Work Schedule: On-site | Shifting | Rotational Job Summary Take ownership of Workforce Management from forecast to real-time execution. enablesGROUP is looking for an experienced Workforce Management (WFM) Lead to own the end-to-end workforce cycle across our Philippine delivery operations. This is a hands-on, single-owner WFM role covering forecasting, capacity planning, schedule architecture, real-time management, coverage governance, and workforce reporting . We're looking for someone who doesn't simply operate a WFM tool. You should be able to take a demand requirement, build the appropriate staffing and schedule model from the ground up, and rapidly rebuild it when requirements change . If client forecasts shift, attrition impacts coverage, deployment dates move, or demand unexpectedly peaks, you'll be expected to determine what needs to change and implement a coverage-compliant solution. What You'll Be Doing Workforce Scheduling & Optimisation Design workforce schedules directly from interval-level demand and staffing requirements . Determine appropriate shift start times, RDO patterns, break placement, and staffing distribution based on actual demand. Rebuild schedules on demand when forecasts, headcount, waves, attrition, or client requirements change. Maintain appropriate interval coverage while accounting for shrinkage. Optimise schedules for both service-level coverage and paid-hour efficiency . Use solver-based or programmatic optimisation where appropriate for complex scheduling scenarios. Manage RDO patterns, RDO swaps, RDOT, shift bids, and schedule exceptions. Publish schedules at least 14 days in advance . Model alternative staffing and scheduling scenarios to support operational and commercial decisions. Forecasting & Capacity Planning Build and maintain interval-level volume, AHT, staffing, and FTE requirement models . Translate workforce requirements into hiring, training, and deployment plans. Maintain a rolling 13-week capacity forecast . Identify and escalate projected over- or under-capacity. Track planned versus actual shrinkage across leave, AUX, attrition, training, NCNS, and other drivers. Forecast seasonal, client-market, weather-related, and other demand peaks and ensure coverage is planned in advance. Real-Time Workforce Management Monitor live queue performance, occupancy, schedule adherence, conformance, and service levels . Take immediate action when service levels or coverage are at risk. Execute intraday levers including: Skill reassignment Queue rebalancing Break movement VTO and OT Cross-queue borrowing Establish and maintain clear intraday escalation triggers and actions. Track adherence by agent and wave and coordinate exceptions with Operations and HR. Coverage & Staffing Governance Maintain live overs/unders coverage grids that respond to roster changes. Report daily and interval-level staffing position against requirements. Quantify both the cost impact of overstaffing and service-level risk of understaffing . Clearly identify structural coverage gaps where available headcount or shift constraints prevent a zero-breach schedule. Recommend the headcount or scheduling changes required to close identified gaps. Reporting & Stakeholder Management Produce accurate daily, weekly, and monthly WFM reporting for senior operations and client stakeholders. Ensure reporting reconciles from interval through daily, weekly, wave, and program levels. Support client performance reviews with staffing, capacity, and adherence analysis. Provide costed staffing impacts when client requirements change. Partner closely with Operations, Recruitment, Training, and HR to align hiring waves, training timelines, certification, and deployment with workforce requirements. What We're Looking For 4+ years of contact centre Workforce Management experience . At least 2 years of hands-on ownership of scheduling and real-time management for a live client-facing program. Demonstrated ability to architect schedules from demand curves and rebuild them when requirements change . Strong experience building interval-level staffing, requirement, and coverage models independently. Advanced Excel skills , including SUMPRODUCT, INDEX/MATCH, array logic, and multi-sheet linked models. Strong working knowledge of: AHT Occupancy Shrinkage Schedule adherence and conformance Erlang-based staffing requirements Overs/unders AUX and NCNS RDO/RDOT Proven ability to manage workforce coverage during peak periods and unplanned events . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Confidence presenting and defending staffing recommendations to senior leadership and client stakeholders . Willingness to work onsite in Ortigas on shifting schedules, including night shifts , based on client coverage requirements. Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in a quantitative operational role. Highly Desirable Experience in time-critical or emergency-response service environments . Hands-on experience with WFM platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria/Aspect, Calabrio, or Genesys WFM . Experience with Python, SQL, or Power BI for reporting and automation. Exposure to linear programming, solver-based, or programmatic schedule optimisation . Experience establishing or scaling a WFM function rather than only working within an established WFM team. Experience managing multiple programs or clients with different service-level requirements . How Success Will Be Measured You'll have clear ownership of workforce outcomes, including: ≥98% interval coverage compliance Same-day schedule rebuilds for single-queue requirement changes Full multi-queue rebuilds within 2 business days Achievement of contracted client service levels ≥90% schedule adherence Monthly forecast accuracy within ±5% Weekly forecast accuracy within ±10% Actual shrinkage within 2 percentage points of plan 100% of schedules published at least 14 days ahead Overstaffing maintained at ≤5% of scheduled hours 100% on-time WFM reporting

Also requires 10+ years of job-related experience, or a master's degree plus 8 years of job-related experience. CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS: Department of Defense Secret security clearance is preferred but must be obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required. Qualifications: Imagine working in a world-class engineering environment alongside exceptional talent and with technologies so advanced that many are classified. At our company, you’ll collaborate with engineers developing products and services that help service members, intelligence analysts, and first responders protect our nation. We apply advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, cloud-native computing, and quantum science, to solve complex customer missions across cyber, radio frequency, undersea, space, and other critical domains. The Torpedo Systems Group (TSG) in the company, specializes in software and hardware system integration, advanced research and development, and manufacturing. We provide mission-critical systems, services, and products to the Department of Defense, government agencies, and commercial customers. Our areas of expertise include technology insertion, acoustic sensors, signal processing, combat systems, torpedoes, cybersecurity, knowledge management, and electronic warfare. The Role: As the Lead Principal Engineer supporting the TSG’s MK48 program, you will serve as a senior technical authority for complex electronic systems. You will define, develop, and evaluate system and hardware architectures; ensure compliance with technical requirements; resolve challenging engineering problems; and guide multidisciplinary teams through design, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustainment. This role combines system-level architectural ownership with hands-on technical engagement in design reviews, laboratory investigations, integration activities, and technical problem resolution. What you’ll do: • Define, develop, and evaluate system and hardware architectures incorporating digital, analog, power-electronics, and mechanical elements. • Translate system requirements into clear, robust hardware requirements, interfaces, and design solutions. • Provide technical leadership for complex circuit design, modeling, simulation, integration, verification, and qualification activities; contribute directly to technical investigations as needed. • Ensure designs satisfy performance, reliability, cybersecurity, producibility, cost, schedule, and lifecycle objectives. • Provide technical direction to digital, analog, power-electronics, mechanical, software, and test engineers. • Serve as a technical mentor and independent reviewer, promoting sound engineering practices and disciplined technical decision-making. • Lead design reviews, architecture assessments, failure reviews, trade studies, and technical investigations. • Identify technical risks; assess their performance, cost, schedule, and program impacts; and develop effective mitigation strategies. • Perform root-cause analysis of development, production, and fielded-system issues; develop and implement corrective actions and design improvements based on test results, failure data, and engineering analysis. • Evaluate embedded processors, systems-on-chip, FPGAs, memory devices, high-speed digital interfaces, and other emerging technologies for current and future applications. • Support product roadmaps, technology-insertion strategies, technical proposals, and future capability development. • Identify practical opportunities to apply artificial intelligence to engineering analysis, automation, and continuous improvement. • Communicate technical findings, recommendations, risks, and decisions to engineering leadership, program teams, customers, and suppliers. What you bring to the table: • Extensive experience designing, integrating, and troubleshooting complex electronic systems involving analog, digital, power-electronics, and mechanical interfaces, with deep technical expertise in one or more of these areas. • Demonstrated ability to make, communicate, and defend system- and hardware-architecture decisions. • Experience with high-performance embedded processors, FPGA or SoC based systems, memory technologies, and high-speed digital interfaces; experience with serial interfaces operating at 5 Gbps or greater is preferred. • Experience with DC/DC and DC/AC power conversion, power distribution, and power-system design. • Proficiency developing and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, bills of material, interface documentation, and design-analysis artifacts. • Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, shielding, electromagnetic compatibility, component derating, and electronic reliability. • Experience with mixed-signal circuit design; high-frequency magnetics experience is preferred. • Hands-on proficiency using oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, logic analyzers, probes, and related laboratory equipment. • Experience integrating and testing electronic assemblies within complex mechanical systems or constrained mechanical environments. • Familiarity with Siemens EDA/Mentor Graphics, OrCAD, PSpice, LTspice, Mathcad, or equivalent schematic-capture, simulation, and analysis tools. • Experience supporting products through development, qualification, production, sustainment, failure investigation, and corrective action. • Strong technical judgment, analytical ability, and written and verbal communication skills. • Ability to work across multiple programs and disciplines while maintaining technical quality and execution commitments. • Experience developing electronic systems for undersea, naval, defense, aerospace, or other high-reliability applications. • Familiarity with DoD systems-engineering, cybersecurity, qualification, and configuration-management practices. • Experience with technical baselines, requirements traceability, verification planning, production readiness, obsolescence management, technology insertion, and design certification. • Familiarity with Earned Value Management and Control Account Management principles is a plus. What we offer: • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development. • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more Skills and Certifications [note: bold skills and certification are required] expert level experience in Electrical/Electronic architecture expert level experience with FPGAs Base Salary - USD $180,000 to $200,000 or more as we have had 2 very high level people interview for this position previously Benefits - Full Relocation Assistance Available - Possible for ideal candidate 10+ to 15 years experience Seniority Level - Mid-Senior Minimum Education - Bachelor's Degree Willingness to Travel - Occasionally

review_candidates.title: Quality Inspector
review_candidates.description: About Crown Crown Holdings, Inc. through it's subsidiaries, is a world leader in the metal packaging production process. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative and sustainable metal packaging solutions and products. Our clients are some of the largest and most respected companies in the world. Crown is dedicated to building a team of highly talented, dedicated, and driven individuals. It's an exciting time to join our business because Crown offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry. Crown was founded with the goal of valuing and promoting sustainability and this vision continues to be essential to our long-term future. Job Description Resumen del Puesto** El Inspector de Calidad es responsable de asegurar que los productos de Vichisa, S.A. de C.V. cumplan con los estándares de calidad establecidos y las especificaciones del cliente. Realizará inspecciones en diferentes etapas del proceso de producción para identificar y reportar no conformidades. Responsabilidades del Puesto** Realizar inspecciones visuales y dimensionales de materias primas, productos en proceso y productos terminados utilizando herramientas de medición adecuadas (calibradores, micrómetros, etc.). Verificar el cumplimiento de los productos con planos, especificaciones técnicas y estándares de calidad internos y externos. Documentar los resultados de las inspecciones, incluyendo la identificación de defectos, no conformidades y acciones correctivas sugeridas. Colaborar con los equipos de producción para investigar las causas raíz de los problemas de calidad y apoyar la implementación de soluciones. Mantener registros precisos y actualizados de los datos de calidad. Participar en la calibración y mantenimiento de los equipos de inspección. Contribuir a la mejora continua de los procesos de calidad. Cumplir con las políticas de seguridad y calidad de la empresa. Cualificaciones del Puesto** Educación secundaria completa; se valorará formación técnica en control de calidad, manufactura o campo relacionado. Experiencia previa de al menos 1-2 años en un rol de inspección de calidad en un entorno de manufactura, preferiblemente en la industria relevante para Vichisa, S.A. de C.V. Conocimiento de herramientas y técnicas de medición (calibradores, micrómetros, medidores de altura, etc.). Capacidad para leer e interpretar planos técnicos y especificaciones. Atención al detalle y habilidad para identificar defectos visuales y dimensionales. Habilidades básicas de computación para el registro de datos (ej. Microsoft Excel). Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo. Comunicación efectiva oral y escrita. Disponibilidad para trabajar en turnos si es requerido.
